get.summary: Recent decisions from every issuer (workers and the API), newest first.

post.summary:
Block a source everywhere now: a decision signed with the API's key and
published to every PoP. Always expires.
All PoPs to observe mode (or back).
Trust a worker's decisions (published to every PoP through KV).
Revoke an issuer: every PoP refuses its decisions from then on.
Finish enrolment with a code from the app; 2FA is then required at login.
Start TOTP enrolment: returns a new secret (stored encrypted until enabled).
Second login step for users with 2FA.
Request a password reset link. Always 202.
Set a new password with the emailed token. Ends every session.

Create an account. Always answers 202 so the endpoint does not reveal
which addresses are registered; an existing address gets a notice mail.

delete.summary: Remove a passkey. The last remaining second factor cannot be removed.

post.summary: Finish the passkey step: the session counts as 2FA-verified.

Start the passkey step of a login. Returns the
PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions for navigator.credentials.get().

Finish adding a passkey. The first passkey (with no authenticator app)
turns 2FA on: every other session of the user is logged out.

Start adding a passkey. Returns the PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions
(`{"publicKey": {...}}`) for navigator.credentials.create().
Create an API key (owners with 2FA). The key is returned once.
Protect a server: allocates a protected IP and starts in observe mode.

put.summary: Replace the asset's policy (ADR 0017: policy is per protected IP).

get.summary: "Active on X of Y PoPs", from the agents' acknowledgements.
The script the customer runs on the origin (spec section 11.6).

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Use an existing tunnel device (e.g. tunl0) instead of creating one.

post.summary:
Tunnel test (ADR 0020): every live PoP pings the protected IP through
the tunnel; a reply proves delivery and the return tunnel.

get.summary: Live traffic for the overview (WebSocket, 1 frame per second, JSON).

101.description: WebSocket; text frames carry LiveFrame JSON

post.summary:
Allow or block sources for this tenant's protected IPs. Customers can
never create global rules; prefixes wider than the configured limit and
/0 are refused.
Add an existing, verified user to the tenant.

Notify a Discord or Slack channel, an HTTP endpoint (signed) or an email
address when attacks start and end.
Sends a test notification now.

ActiveAttack.description: An attack in progress (spec 13.4: the overview shows them live).

dropped_ratio.description: Share of the attack traffic the PoPs drop (0..1).

pops_applied.description: PoPs that acknowledged this version of the asset and its services.

pops_total.description: PoPs seen in the last 30 seconds.

protected_prefix.description: The protected IP (allocated from the anycast prefix).

samples.description: Rates over time (one sample per worker report).

dropped_ratio.description: Share of the attack traffic dropped at the PoPs (0..1).

origin_ip.description: The customer's own server: tunnel destination.

services.description: Ports to allow (only enforced once enforce_services is on).

target.description: URL (discord, slack, http) or email address.

secret.description: HTTP webhooks only, shown once: verify X-Sentinel-Signature with it.

observe.description: true: every PoP counts verdicts but drops nothing.

LiveFrame.description: One WebSocket message (JSON text frame), once per second.

pops.description: One entry per PoP that reported in the last 5 seconds.

credential.description: The PublicKeyCredential from navigator.credentials.get(), as JSON.

csrf_token.description: Send back in X-CSRF-Token on every state-changing request.

src.description: Source address or prefix to block.

key.description: Shown once; only its hash is stored.

public_key.description: Base64 Ed25519 public key (`sentinel-worker key generate`).

mode.description: observe (count only) or mitigate (drop). Mitigate needs 2FA.

Rates.description: Packets and bits per second, split the way the overview graph shows them.

clean_pps.description: in - filtered: what reaches (or would reach) the origin.

filtered_pps.description:
Traffic the filters reject: dropped in mitigate mode, only counted
in observe mode.

in_pps.description: Everything that arrived for the tenant's protected IPs.

return_pps.description: The origin's replies forwarded by the PoPs (return tunnel).

credential.description: The PublicKeyCredential from navigator.credentials.create(), as JSON.

name.description: A label for the passkey, e.g. "Laptop".

port.description: TCP/UDP destination port; omit for every port of the protocol.

tenant_name.description: Name of the customer account (tenant) created with the user.

ok.description:
Every live PoP reached the protected IP through the tunnel (and at
least one PoP is live).
At least one probe came back through the tunnel.

session.name: xs_session
session.description: Session cookie from /auth/login; state-changing requests also need X-CSRF-Token
